changeAlert.title: Permission Change Notice
changeAlert.description: Changes to permissions take effect only after you log in again (permissions are embedded in the JWT); the server-side cache expires after about 5 minutes.

roleDescriptions.OPERATOR: All read/write permissions, excluding system management, security management manage, and infrastructure
roleDescriptions.USER: Dashboard + configuration read-only + traffic governance + monitoring read-only + tracing search + AI playground
roleDescriptions.AUDITOR: Third-party audit minimum: overview, audit events, console operations; no business data, no writes
roleDescriptions.SLA_READONLY: SLA inspection, read-only: monitoring and config read surfaces; no key/account/permission management
roleDescriptions.SLA_OPERATOR: SLA inspection with control-plane writes: read surfaces plus rate-limit/circuit-breaker/monitoring/tracing writes

messages.loadRolesFailed: Failed to load role permissions, please retry
messages.saveSuccess: Permissions saved; changes take effect after re-login
messages.saveFailed: Failed to save permissions, please retry
messages.resetApplied: Reset to the permissions saved on the server
